bench.note: Log-loss, lower is better; the bookmaker column only covers matches it priced (n=8,693). The model never sees these prices: the market leads on 1X2 (line-ups, injuries and money move its lines), while from football data alone the model sits within 0.007 of it on Over 2.5.

bias.note: Backtest of 24,393 priced matches (2023-26), stable across three-plus seasons: public money inflates longshots — outcomes priced 5-20% win less than the price implies — while two Over-2.5 bands landed above their implied rate. Context for the comparison layer only; odds never filter selections.
